changes.invariant: BACKGROUND_SLEEP is distinct from PAUSE_PROCESS: queued work may checkpoint and sleep 300..86400 s while another READY mission continues; if no alternate mission exists the worker falls back to a normal timed hold.

A managed worker must remain on the remembered EIC custom-GPT root. Generic/wrong ChatGPT surfaces get a 10 s grace and then recover to last-known-good EIC URL; generic ChatGPT can never overwrite the good root.

Arbetsläge is an opt-in GF-045/responsible-GFW orchestration lane. Backend WMT pointers are freshness/nonce/taskKey validated, deduped into a local prequeue, and materialized as separate Greenfield workers when scheduler capacity permits. Existing manual Uppdragskö remains unchanged.

Work Mode is disabled by default, polls at most every 15 s only from the bound supervisor worker, respects profile scheduler capacity before creating a child worker, and does not add owner/API traffic to ordinary Greenfield sessions.
